details.name: ISO 19005-4:2020 - 6.3.2 Annotation dictionaries - F key
details.description: All annotation dictionaries shall contain the F key, except for annotation dictionaries whose Subtype key has a value of Popup or those whose Rect key’s value is an array where the value at index 0 is equal to the value at index 2 and the value at index 1 is equal to the value at index 3
